dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 151 times.

Showing how two maps can interact with each other through a server-level Counter. This map and map 1470. You have two cases who are both in shock. You need to judge who is in most need for fluid resuscitation.
You have a maximum of 4 units of saline available. Use them judiciously on both cases or else you will run out… which is not a good thing.
